[RIDGELINE GAZETTE SUBSCRIPTIONS]

Charged $24.00 to your card on file. Your annual Ridgeline Gazette subscription is active. Full access to Ridgeline school data and tour booking is unlocked.

[THE RIDGELINE GAZETTE]

Here is a rundown of the eight elementary schools in the Fairmont district, ranked by state proficiency scores. All figures are the latest available year.

---

TOP PERFORMERS IN THE NEIGHBORHOOD

Cedar Street Elementary (RG-039)
- ELA proficiency: 92% -- ranks 10th among all Ridgeline elementary schools
- Math proficiency: 94% -- ranks 8th in Ridgeline

Fox Hollow Elementary (RG-107)
- ELA proficiency: 91% -- ranks 12th in Ridgeline
- Math proficiency: 93% -- ranks 10th in Ridgeline

Northgate Elementary (RG-321)
- ELA proficiency: 89% -- ranks 14th in Ridgeline
- Math proficiency: 91% -- ranks 13th in Ridgeline
- Also the largest school in the neighborhood at 1,309 students -- a well-known and highly sought-after school

---

STRONG MID-TIER OPTIONS

Ridgeline Magnet School of Math and Design (RG-010)
- ELA proficiency: 87%
- Math proficiency: 84%
- Largest enrollment after Northgate at 844 students; focuses on STEM

Willow Creek Community School (RG-118)
- ELA proficiency: 82%
- Math proficiency: 83%
- Smaller school at 202 students

Bell Avenue Elementary (RG-133)
- ELA proficiency: 75%
- Math proficiency: 72%

Fairmont Elementary (RG-282)
- ELA proficiency: 71%
- Math proficiency: 75%

Old Mill Elementary (RG-124)
- Proficiency data not in the Ridgeline-wide top 100 for either metric

---

SUMMARY

The standouts by test performance are Cedar Street, Fox Hollow, and Northgate -- all ranking in the top 15 among Ridgeline elementary schools on both ELA and math. Note that zoning determines which of these your child is eligible for; if you share your address I can tell you which school's zone you fall in.

Would you like to book a tour at any of these schools, or would you like deeper data on a specific one -- such as attendance, class size, or chronic absenteeism?
